title: Cohomology of Finite Element Stokes Complexes on Alfeld Splits
summary: We show that the cohomology of the finite element Stokes complex consisting of piecewise polynomials spaces on an Alfeld split mesh from Fu, Guzmán, & Neilan (2020, Math. Comp., 89, 1059--1091) is isomorphic to the cohomologies of the continuous Stokes and de Rham complexes. We also construct novel "minimal" conforming finite element complexes where the $H^1$-conforming space is the lowest-order space from Guzmán & Neilan (2018, SIAM J. Numer. Anal., 56, 2826--2844) and the $L^2$-conforming space is piecewise constants. These minimal complexes also have cohomologies isomorphic to the…
